hook: Ranigunj RUB: *one lane* open for 6-8 months from Nov 20
hook_b: Ranigunj RUB: *one lane* open for 6-8 months from Nov 20
tldr: Railways are renovating the Ranigunj Railway Under Bridge on MG Road, Secunderabad, from Nov 20 for six to eight months. Excavation across nearly three lanes leaves one carriageway for two-wheelers, autos and cars. Buses and goods vehicles are diverted.

beats.what: Hyderabad traffic police announced restrictions and diversions at Ranigunj Junction for the RUB renovation, starting Nov 20.
beats.why: Ranigunj sits on MG Road linking Secunderabad to Tank Bund, a main route for RTC buses and goods traffic.
beats.care: Commuters via Paradise, Patny, Tank Bund and Karbala should expect jams; heavy vehicles must take the diversion routes.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today (Nov 18): police will also install 10-ft height restrictors at five junctions to stop oversized vehicles.

cards.q: How will the Ranigunj closure change your commute?

qs: How will RTC bus routes through Secunderabad change for daily riders?
Will the 6-8 month timeline hold once excavation starts?

facts.t: Police have listed *18* junctions where congestion is expected, including Paradise, Patny and Karbala.

viz.verdict: Only light vehicles get through; buses and trucks diverted
Heavy vehicles rerouted at several junctions

steps.e: Restrictions begin on MG Road, Secunderabad
RTC buses, goods and travel buses barred from the RUB
Height-restrictor railings at Patny, Paradise, Park Lane, Rasoolpura, Karbala

watch: How the first weekday rush on Nov 20 goes at Paradise, Patny and Karbala, and any tweaks to the diversion plan.
